prior_information: V1 wiring, all historical studies, current-state shortcut, v2 finite-fixture bounds and key coverage are opened. No v2 substantive model fit or empirical prediction score has been read. This is predeclared public development, not independent preregistered challenge evidence.
hypotheses: After all bits are reset, informative history can improve final-contact predictions over the information-limited condition; it need not improve pooled all-step accuracy.
Compare persistent versus reset memory at identical parameters and initialization; report whether errors remain despite informative evidence.
Compare learned and supplied persistence in both families, and tied versus untied mode hypotheses; differences also change capacity and do not isolate architectural superiority.
Strong measured-outcome controls can expose memorization/local abstraction explanations for apparent composition transfer.

data.case_order: 0..255, then six lexicographic permutations of sorted anchor IDs
data.second_pair_interpretation: opened chronological composition; exact prefix overlap for steps 0..2 only, all local and contact-abstraction keys overlap training
data.sensor_contract: Full noiseless readings. Feed the same observed/action tensors to every model/control in a condition. No hidden mode or future target in a predict call. The complete offline array is evaluator-inspectable, not a security boundary.
data.bounds: Informative query history ceiling 1.0, current-only 0.625; uninformative both 0.625. Informative step 2 ceiling 0.5. All other steps 1.0. All-step ceilings 0.9375 and 0.953125 respectively. These are not G1 targets.

factory: informative_curriculum.model_factories; exact defaults, no width search or parameter selection
control_fit: SensorMemory fits once on each training condition only. no_change is a point mass on the current measured full state. prefix/local/contact preserve measured frequencies and zero support; unknown keys abstain with no fallback. Save full tables and digests. Contact-history abstraction is supplied, not learned physics or a general nucleus.

regimes.completion: All 128 updates required; an early CPU stop makes the study incomplete.
At least one update required; report last-step overshoot and whether the update guard rather than CPU bound was reached.

fit.optimizer: Pinned joint_objective.fit Adam defaults in PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu; lr=0.02, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, amsgrad=False. No minibatches, calibration, early-stopping selection, scheduling, weight decay, clipping or restarts.
fit.loss: Unchanged joint_objective.full_world_nll: mean joint complete-state negative log likelihood, equal weight to all 12,288 events, all eight worlds, full backpropagation through the within-episode state. Float64.
fit.order: Regime order as listed, condition order as listed, seed order as listed. Within each cell, rotate listed model order left by (regime_index + condition_index + seed_index) modulo 6.
fit.initialization: torch.manual_seed(seed) immediately before each factory call. Retain initial state_dict; same model/seed must have identical initial tensor fingerprints across conditions and regimes. Equal initial seeds do not imply equal architectures.
fit.compute: Record actual process CPU and wall seconds, setup costs, updates, events processed, last-step duration and overshoot. Equal exposure is not equal compute; equal CPU ceilings are not equal consumed CPU/FLOPs. No concurrent neural fits.
fit.checkpoints: Save initial and final CPU state_dict for all 120 fits, byte hashes, semantic tensor fingerprints and per-fit training metadata immediately. Verify strict weights_only restoration and fingerprint equality. No missing fit may be dropped or replaced.
fit.before_scores: Complete all fits and control tables before any evaluation summary or model selection. Fit, checkpoint, replay and score phases are separately recorded.

environment.record: Exact Python/PyTorch/platform/CPU, torch configuration hash, commits, source/data hashes, thread counts, deterministic flags, wall/process CPU and peak RSS with units. No cross-host bitwise guarantee.

evaluation.mode: All models eval with inference_mode; no parameter, calibration or control-table updates. Reset recurrent state per episode; preserve it within the episode. Save each forecast before receiving that step feedback. Same measured history, not free-running rollouts.
evaluation.normalization: Before any score/MAP comparison, apply ONE uniform log-domain normalization to every predicted 8-world vector, including controls. Reject NaN/+inf or nonfinite total, require abs(raw logsumexp)<=1e-10, then subtract it. Keep all raw/normalized log values and correction. -inf stays -inf. Validate exp masses finite in [0,1] and sum within 1e-12. No clipping, smoothing, imputation or materially invalid mass repair. Training loss stays unchanged.
evaluation.numerical_zeros: Serialize -inf as null plus explicit negative_infinity status. Retain finite log probabilities even when exp underflows to zero; record underflow. Neural NLL uses normalized log probability directly, not log(exp(logp)). Structural -inf gives infinite NLL; controls zero support gives infinite NLL. Any aggregate containing an infinite answered loss has null mean plus infinite status/count; never average only finite losses.
evaluation.map: Lexicographically first maximizer in sorted-ID world order; retain all exact maximizers and tie count. Renaming can change the chosen MAP at equal probabilities; report this separately from distribution sensitivity.
evaluation.primary: Per seed/regime/model/condition/fixture: complete-world MAP accuracy at step 6, with denominator all 1,536 queries and explicit answered/abstained counts. Compare informative minus uninformative and second-pair minus same-pair for every arm; truth at final query is identical across information conditions for matched physical case/view.
evaluation.secondary: All eight steps separately, full-case all-steps MAP correctness WITH real feedback, uncapped joint NLL, full eight-world Brier, unchanged-bit errors, and both-directions-correct for 768 case-XOR-1 view pairs at query. No metric substitutes for the untouched G1 gate.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report proper scores on all cases plus groups with >1 outcome under identical preforecast evidence. Query uninformative Bayes floors are 0.75*ln(2) NLL and 0.375 Brier; informative probe floors ln(2) and 0.5. Compute descriptive 10-bin ECE using [i/10,(i+1)/10), with last bin including 1. No claim of independently calibrated uncertainty.
evaluation.abstention: None from fixed neural variants; controls may abstain. Preserve status/reason, coverage, accuracy among answers, correct/wrong/abstained per all queries. Never invent probability scores for abstentions. Report model comparisons on common answered subsets AND all-query correct/wrong/abstained counts.
evaluation.paired_regressions: For each seed/regime/condition/fixture/step compare every arm to flat and to kernel_learned_persistence on identical case/view. Also compare each arm between conditions/regimes. Retain correct-to-wrong, wrong-to-correct, correct-to-abstained and abstained-to-correct IDs, not just net improvements.
evaluation.renaming: Per physical case inverse-map all six view distributions to identity coordinates, compare to identity view with TV tolerance 1e-10, report max/median TV, distribution changes and MAP/tie changes separately. These views are correlated.
evaluation.latency: Per-fit batched forward sequence wall/process CPU measured after one discarded replay of the first already-scored physical case, repeated 20 times without learning. Report batch size, whole-sequence p50/p95 nearest-rank; do not relabel batched averages as single-query service latency.
evaluation.interpretation: All seeds, worst seed and mean; no iid confidence interval over permutations or seeds as independent physical worlds. No architecture-superiority, matched-capacity, independent generalization, partial-observation, learned probing, language or 3x claim.

execution.review: Protocol frozen before substantive fits/scores. A separate runner commit and implementation review must precede execution. No independent scientific review is claimed by this manifest.
execution.lineage: Require exact protocol and source hashes, complete clean tracked checkout, source_commit ancestry and a later runner commit. Record runner/workflow/test hashes before enabling a manually guarded one-attempt workflow. No implicit run in ordinary invariant CI.
execution.output: New nonexistent directory outside source checkout, parent must exist; never overwrite. Stream per-fit metadata/checkpoints then per-case raw forecasts, all coordinate maps, full histories, truth, scores and diagnostics. Strict JSON with explicit nonfinite tags. Source and data provenance retained.
execution.failure: Any missing/invalid fit, checkpoint, data, forecast or inventory aborts with nonzero exit and FAILED metadata; preserve completed work and raw offending record. No COMPLETE or success summary for partial work. No silent retries or post-score tuning; changes require a new explicitly labelled protocol.
execution.success: Validate all 120 fits and all seeds/conditions/regimes/models/fixtures/views/steps, checkpoints/table hashes, score denominators and paired contrasts; emit report and COMPLETE last. Retain full raw output and checkpoint bundle in durable research storage, not only expiring CI artifacts.
execution.caps: Single CPU process, 30-minute job cap; record any timeout and available partial evidence. No repeated attempts merely to get a better host budget.

decision: G1 HOLD / REVISE regardless of this opened diagnostic. Next G1 admission work needs independent held challenge, partial/noisy observation, stronger capacity/budget controls and separately demonstrated acquisition.
